content: Hi. I'm Dokying. I have fully formalised these results in lean : 1. Ax-Sen lemma in the char 0 and char p case; (the valuation bound, rather than the Ax-Sen-Tate theorem) 2. Hilbert's formula for valuation of the different ideal (along with basics of ramification groups); 3. the Krull-Akizuki theorem; 4. finite extension of local fields have solvable Galois group; 5. the projection theorem $\operatorname{Res}_S^G(A \otimes B) \cong \operatorname{Res}_S^G(A) \otimes \operatorname{Res}_S^G(B)$ (one can deduce Frobenius reciprocity from this but I know not how to proceed the other way round, and this is more suitable for computation). For the FLT project I have contributed Dickson's classification for finite subgroups of PGL_2(\bar{F_p}). Items 2 and 4 from the above list were built on lean 4.26.0-rc2, and I will try to update them soon.

Hi Dokying! Thanks for your proof of Dickson, I merged it into FLT recently. I also need 4 for FLT. I would recommend you use AI to bump to 4.31, AI is getting good at this sort of task now (I used AI to bump your 4.26 proof of the classification of finite subgroups of PGL2(F‾p)PGL_2(\overline{\mathbb{F}}_p)PGL2​(Fp​) to 4.31).
Krull-Akizuki would be great to get into mathlib eventually to remove the separability hypothesis from docs#IsIntegralClosure.isDedekindDomain

@Kevin Buzzard Thanks! I had manually updated it to 4.32 then found out Claude had done it. Marvellous! I will look closely at mathlib updates since 4.26, because when I embarked on the Dickson project even PGL was not available in Mathlib (but PSL was), now we have much more infrastructure available. I heard that ramification groups, etc. have also been formalized and I will check. I will update and PR it within this week.
@Thomas Browning Exactly. I formalized Krull-Akizuki because I was annoyed for having to add redundant hypotheses for my proof of Hilbert's formula. I have just PRed it to mathlib. Hope it will help.
